description: Use this when the person has a specific upcoming meeting or call and wants to be ready for it. This is the default for "prepare me for my call". Returns a short brief: what the meeting is for and what each person in the room likely thinks going in (what they want, the concerns they need answered, what moves them, and where they'll disagree), built from the account's buying committee and labelled as Andru's assumptions to correct. Send the meeting (from their calendar, or described in a sentence), what kind of meeting it is, and who will be there by title. If you leave out who's in the room, Andru answers with the six buyers to choose from. To talk with the buyers before the meeting, use simulate_buyer_persona with the same brief.

companyName.description: Company you're meeting. Andru looks for the matching meeting on the person's calendar.

meeting.description: The meeting in a sentence if it isn't on their calendar, e.g. 'pricing call with the company's VP of Finance and their IT lead'.

meetingId.description: The meeting from the person's calendar (an id from a previous reply). Leave it out and describe the meeting in `meeting` instead.

room.description: Who will be there: up to 8 people, each with their title and, if you know it, which of the six buyers they are.

situation.description: What kind of meeting: a discovery call, where they speak first; a deal meeting (demo, pricing, pilot, procurement); or a customer review.

stage.description: Where the deal is, by the last thing the buyer did (required for a deal meeting).

name: get_pre_brief
title: Prepare for a meeting
